metadata.title: Chatbot QA Checklist
metadata.purpose: Manual or automated validation for language routing, luxury tone, typo tolerance, and product intent handling

validationRules: English input must return professional English output.
Hindi or Hinglish input must return natural Hindi output.
Tone must remain official, human, concise, and user-friendly.
Common spelling mistakes should still map to the correct user intent.
Product requests should show relevant shortlist behavior.

testCases.expected: English, premium-professional response; asks or refines as needed
Interprets typo query correctly; product intent still works
Still interpreted as how-are-you; polished English reply
Hindi typo query understood; similar intent result to T05
Hindi support response with return policy details
English support response; refund intent understood

testCases.prompt: show mens black shirt size m
sho me mnz blak shrt siz m
testCases.expected: Misspelled product filters still interpreted correctly

regressionChecks.check: Chat widget opens and closes correctly on desktop and mobile
No console runtime errors during chat flow
Cached repeat prompts feel faster than first request
Product cards remain visible and relevant after typo queries
Fallback replies remain professional and avoid robotic or slang output
